name: Akase
source:
As Isamu's classmate, Akase hails from a reputable family and boasts a well-cultured upbringing. His personality is as large as his appetite, both displaying his generous nature.

Akase holds Isamu in high esteem, cherishing their bond as a true friendship.
translation:
As Isamu's classmate, Akase hails from a reputable family and boasts a well-cultured upbringing. His personality is as large as his appetite, both displaying his generous nature.

Akase holds Isamu in high esteem, cherishing their bond as a true friendship.
